claimBoundary: Selected-fixture emission and validation guard for the 13 Forge free targets only; it uses local toolchain checks where available and structural checks otherwise, and makes no all-free-target public readiness, compiler correctness, formal equivalence, publication, runtime performance, hardware, Pro-target, or all-target readiness claim.
nonClaims: FEF-P31 records selected-fixture emission for the 13 Forge free targets.
FEF-P31 uses local syntax/toolchain checks where tools are installed and structural checks where they are not.
FEF-P31 does not claim all free targets are public-ready.
FEF-P31 does not claim compiler correctness or formal semantic equivalence.
FEF-P31 does not publish a package, enable checkout, or claim production readiness.
FEF-P31 does not claim runtime performance, Verilog, silicon, hardware, Pro-target, or all-target readiness.
reviewHighlights: All 13 free targets emitted non-empty artifacts for examples/verified_add.eml.
C, C++, Rust, Python, JavaScript, Java, Lean, and zkproof received local toolchain or parser checks.
Go, Kotlin, C#, MATLAB, and wasm received bounded structural checks in this environment.
The guard is selected-fixture evidence only and does not publish or widen public preview claims.
title: FEF-P31 Free Target Emission Guard
